# Do not assume POP3 stale-partial cleanup propagates every failure

DiscardStalePartialMessages closes its scan stream before returning a scan failure, but EndMailDelivery ignores the cleanup return. The deletion loop initializes found=true and calls CheckMessage without checking its returned status; the checked protocol implementation queries its session UIDL map. Existing knowledge covers the account match, Partial filter and one NotifyDelete after successful DB header deletions. When changing this path, keep those identity conditions and check these separate failure boundaries. Deleting a database header here is not proof that physical store bytes were removed. This is a scoped static source finding and manual review recommendation. No POP3, cleanup, error injection, runtime or build test ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: mailnews/local/src.
